# completion

Emit shell autocompletion script (bash / zsh / powershell)

```text
usage: openprogram completion [-h] {bash,zsh,powershell,pwsh}
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `shell` | Target shell — pipe stdout into your shell rc or eval it. |
